thread:
liam: Heads-up — prod telemetry just surfaced a user-facing regression in text-generation v3.9.0. p95 latency is fine but hallucination rate vs baseline jumped ~2.1% across a small but important customer segment. thinking we should unwind traffic to v3.8.3 and open a rollback runbook.

maya: Ugh. Saw the same in the eval dashboard. Regression tied to the new attention kernel + quant pathway on longer prompts. :face_with_head_bandage:

sre-alex: Agree with unwinding. Do we want auto-rollback or manual? Deploy-bot thresholds didn't trigger because latency/error SLOs are OK. This is quality regression only.

liam: We should do manual rollback for now — notify CS and run the rollback play. We need a short comms slate for impacted customers before we flip.

ops-bot: deploy-bot notice: can perform traffic shift to previous pinned version 3.8.3 with --grace 5m. Awaiting manual approval.

samira: Manual sounds right. We need to preserve logs and request traces for a postmortem. Can we pin a read-only snapshot for debugging after traffic shift?

dev-deploy: Yes — we can create a snapshot of kvcache and full request traces. Plan: (1) pin traffic to 3.8.3, (2) enable request tracing for 30m, (3) capture model inputs for failing cases, (4) open postmortem ticket.

liam: OK — comms: short subject line, one-sentence impact, what we changed, ETA for full root-cause. Rachael from CS to own outbound. Rachael?

rachael-cs: On it. I'll draft a terse note for affected customers: "We've temporarily routed your requests to the prior model due to degraded output quality; no action needed on your side; we expect to restore the improved model once validated." Will ping legal if needed.

maya: Rollback runbook quick checklist for execution channel:
• Who: liam (release lead), maya (model owner), sre-alex (ops), rachael-cs (comms)
• Command: ```deploy-bot traffic set --version=3.8.3 --percent=100 --grace=300```
• Observability: enable tracing tag "regression-debug" and increase sample rate to 100% for 15m
• Post-action: snapshot logs, tag traces, create PM ticket with sample inputs

sre-alex: Adding safety: we'll hold under-call for 10m after command to watch for infra regressions. If anything weird (OOMs, latency spike) we abort and split traffic instead.

dev-deploy: I'll queue the traffic command — need +approve from liam in this thread to proceed.

liam: +approve. Do it now.

ops-bot: deploy-bot action: starting traffic shift to 3.8.3 (initiated by dev-deploy). Progress: 0% -> 40% -> 80% -> 100%

rachael-cs: Sent draft to affected accounts. Included internal contact + Slack channel for updates.

samira: Tracing enabled, sample rate bumped. Tagging traces under "regression-debug/2429001234".

maya: We're seeing immediate drop in hallucination signals in the sample set. Good.

sre-alex: No infra regressions observed during shift. p50/p95 stable.

dev-deploy: Traffic at 100%. Snapshot created at s3://redwood-prod-snapshots/2429001234-kv-snap.tar.gz

liam: Great. Postmortem ticket: PM-4521. I've added owner, timeline, and initial hypothesis (attention kernel mismatch + quant path).

rachael-cs: Customer comms updated to say we routed back to prior model and will reach out when validation complete.

maya: Next steps: isolated repros from traces, try local reproducer with new kernel + quant flags off, run targeted evals on affected prompt sets.

sre-alex: Leaving the runbook open for 24h and monitoring. If we decide to reintroduce v3.9.0, we do a phased canary with per-customer opt-in.

liam: Closing thread for now — marking this as manual-unwind, communication-slate executed. Will re-open if we need to iterate. :white_check_mark:
